name: Golden Coconut Chicken Curry

fit.batch_format: stovetop simmer braise, coconut-cream sauce holds and reheats well
fit.note: 517/16g is the curry-only figure (jasmine/basmati listed as optional for-serving and excluded); clears the band comfortably even if the source figure carries a little rice.

duplicate_check.evidence: Nearest catalog coconut-chicken neighbors are Kuku Paka (Swahili, tomato/lime spicing), Cape Malay Chicken Curry (South African, tomato/potato base), Malaysian Chicken Rendang (same cuisine + protein but dry-braised to a thick kerisik/lemongrass/galangal paste, opposite method), and Vietnamese Ca Ri Ga (lemongrass + potato/carrot). This candidate is a saucy Malaysian golden aromatic-spice curry (star anise + cinnamon + garam masala + coriander + cumin + fennel + turmeric) over chicken thigh + broccoli in coconut cream. Protein and coconut-sauce overlap with several, but flavor family and method distinguish it from each - no three-of-four match to any single catalog dish.

cross_protein_watch: Structurally a golden coconut-cream spice-braise. Coconut-curry-braise family already in play across proteins: thai-coconut-curry-pork-shoulder (accepted) and Thai Coconut Curry Turkey Meatballs / One-Skillet Ground Turkey Thai Curry are the neighbors, but those are Thai curry-paste flavor family, not the same dish. Decider should specifically watch for a beef/turkey/pork twin carrying the SAME Malaysian golden-spice profile (star anise + cinnamon + garam masala + fennel/coriander/cumin in coconut cream) - that would be a same-dish-different-protein collision I cannot see from a single-candidate view.
